title: Mitofsky Poll: Calderón Leads Opposition Ex-Presidents' Image, But Deep Polarization Persists
detail: A Mitofsky poll published August 23, 2026 found Felipe Calderón leading opposition former presidents (PAN and PRI) on every major image indicator — best accomplishments for Mexico, best cabinet, greatest fight against organized crime, and most credibility to discuss current affairs. On security specifically, Calderón scored 24.5% versus 3.6% for second-place Ernesto Zedillo. But the poll's headline finding was that 'none' effectively wins: six in ten respondents could not credit any opposition ex-president on these measures. Opinion was sharply split along partisan lines — roughly 90% negative among 4T (Morena) sympathizers versus 76% favorable among non-sympathizers, a net positive balance of 72.7 points in that group. Mitofsky's analysis concluded the ratings reflect ongoing political dispute rather than a settled historical verdict, describing it as polarization from the present transferred onto memory of the past. President Sheinbaum subsequently cited the poll's findings on public perception of opposition administrations to discuss the Fox and Calderón legacies.
